media_cabinet.observations: Both A and B depict a long, low, three-door cabinet in a grey-green finish. The overall silhouette and proportions (length-to-height ratio) are consistent between the design and the fit. The fit (B) includes visible rivets along the panel edges, aligning with the requested 'riveted military furniture style', whereas the design (A) is a clean, untextured surface. The fit (B) features recessed, dark rectangular handle cutouts on the doors. The design (A) features prominent, silver-colored, external latch-style hardware.
defects: Hardware mismatch: The design specifies external latches, but the fit renders recessed cutouts.
Style inconsistency: The fit introduces rivets that are not present in the clean design render, creating a discrepancy in the intended surface finish.
fixes: Update the design render to include the rivet details to match the fit's military aesthetic.
Modify the fit's geometry to include the external latch hardware shown in the design, or update the design to reflect the recessed cutout style.

observations: Both C and D show a round pedestal table with a central column and a circular base.
The proportions of the top diameter relative to the base and height are identical in both views.
The fit (D) clearly displays a ring of rivets on the top surface and base, consistent with the military style.
The design (C) is a clean, untextured representation of the same rigid geometry.
The transition from the column to the base (the flare) is consistent in both images.
defects: The design (C) lacks the rivet details present in the fit (D), though this is a minor surface detail omission rather than a geometric error.
fixes: Add rivet details to the design render to fully match the fit's surface treatment.
